                                ; ines header
      4E 45 53 1A                     .db $4E,$45,$53,$1A                           ;  magic signature
      08                              .db $08                                       ;  PRG ROM size in 16384 byte units
      10                              .db $10                                       ;  CHR
                                      if BATTERY
      43                                .db $43                                       ;  mirroring type and mapper number lower nibble + battery
                                      else
                                        .db $41                                       ;  mirroring type and mapper number lower nibble
                                      endif
      00                              .db $00                                       ;  mapper number upper nibble
                                
      00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00         .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00
                                
                                ; RAM variables
                                        ; We start at a weird address here because
                                        ; we're adding on to all this defined stuff.
                                        ; Needs cleanup.
                                        .base $07cb

00000                           ; background_scenery
00000                           macro levelHeader scenery_bgcolor, entrance, timer, terrain_control, background_scenery_type, background_scenery
00000                               ; Header (first byte): scenery/bg color + player entrance control * $08 + timer setting * $40
00000                               ; Header (second byte): terrain control + background scenery type * $10 + background scenery * $40
00000                               .db scenery_bgcolor + entrance * $08 + timer * $40
00000                               .db terrain_control + background_scenery_type * $10 + background_scenery * $40

00000                           ; bank 00 -- first half of original SMB code
00000                           base $8000
08000 00                        .db $00                     ; bank identifier
08001                           include code\bank00.asm
08001                           ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
08001                           
08001                           
08001                           if USEIRQ == 1
08001                               include code\reset_new.asm
08001                               include code\nmi_new.asm
08001                           else
08001                               include code\reset.asm
08001                           ;Start:
08001 78                                     sei                          ;pretty standard 6502 type init here
08002 D8                                     cld
08003                                       if DPCM
08003                                         ldx #$00
08003                                         stx $4010
08003                                       endif
08003                           Start:
08003 A9 10                                  lda #%00010000               ;init PPU control register 1 
08005 8D 00 20                               sta PPU_CTRL_REG1
08008 A2 FF                                  ldx #$ff                     ;reset stack pointer
0800A 9A                                     txs
0800B AD 02 20                  VBlank1:     lda PPU_STATUS               ;wait two frames
0800E 10 FB                                  bpl VBlank1
08010 AD 02 20                  VBlank2:     lda PPU_STATUS
08013 10 FB                                  bpl VBlank2
08015 A0 FE                                  ldy #ColdBootOffset          ;load default cold boot pointer
08017 A2 05                                  ldx #$05                     ;this is where we check for a warm boot
08019 BD D7 07                  WBootCheck:  lda TopScoreDisplay,x        ;check each score digit in the top score
0801C C9 0A                                  cmp #10                      ;to see if we have a valid digit
0801E B0 0C                                  bcs ColdBoot                 ;if not, give up and proceed with cold boot
08020 CA                                     dex                      
08021 10 F6                                  bpl WBootCheck
08023 AD FF 07                               lda WarmBootValidation       ;second checkpoint, check to see if 
08026 C9 A5                                  cmp #$a5                     ;another location has a specific value
08028 D0 02                                  bne ColdBoot   
0802A A0 D6                                  ldy #WarmBootOffset          ;if passed both, load warm boot pointer
0802C 20 C2 F4                  ColdBoot:    jsr InitializeMemory         ;clear memory using pointer in Y
0802F 8D 11 40                               sta SND_DELTA_REG+1          ;reset delta counter load register
08032 8D 70 07                               sta OperMode                 ;reset primary mode of operation
08035 A9 A5                                  lda #$a5                     ;set warm boot flag
08037 8D FF 07                               sta WarmBootValidation     
0803A 8D A7 07                               sta PseudoRandomBitReg       ;set seed for pseudorandom register
0803D A9 0F                                  lda #%00001111
0803F 8D 15 40                               sta SND_MASTERCTRL_REG       ;enable all sound channels except dmc
08042 A9 06                                  lda #%00000110
08044 8D 01 20                               sta PPU_CTRL_REG2            ;turn off clipping for OAM and background
08047 20 BD F3                               jsr MoveAllSpritesOffscreen
0804A 20 D4 F4                               jsr InitializeNameTables     ;initialize both name tables
0804D EE 74 07                               inc DisableScreenFlag        ;set flag to disable screen output
08050 AD 78 07                               lda Mirror_PPU_CTRL_REG1
08053 09 80                                  ora #%10000000               ;enable NMIs
08055 20 29 F4                               jsr WritePPUReg1
08058                           
08058                                       if USEIRQ == 1
08058                                           lda #$40                    ; disable frame counter to make irq work
08058                                           sta $4017
08058                                           
08058                                           cli                         ; Clear interrupt Disable Bit (so we can use irqs)
08058                                       endif
08058                           
08058 4C 58 80                  EndlessLoop: jmp EndlessLoop              ;endless loop, need I say more?
0805B                               include code\nmi.asm
0805B                           NonMaskableInterrupt:
0805B AD 78 07                                 lda Mirror_PPU_CTRL_REG1  ;disable NMIs in mirror reg
0805E 29 7F                                    and #%01111111            ;save all other bits
08060 8D 78 07                                 sta Mirror_PPU_CTRL_REG1
08063 29 7E                                    and #%01111110            ;alter name table address to be $2800
08065 8D 00 20                                 sta PPU_CTRL_REG1         ;(essentially $2000) but save other bits
08068 AD 79 07                                 lda Mirror_PPU_CTRL_REG2  ;disable OAM and background display by default
0806B 29 E6                                    and #%11100110
0806D AC 74 07                                 ldy DisableScreenFlag     ;get screen disable flag
08070 D0 05                                    bne ScreenOff             ;if set, used bits as-is
08072 AD 79 07                                 lda Mirror_PPU_CTRL_REG2  ;otherwise reenable bits and save them
08075 09 1E                                    ora #%00011110
08077 8D 79 07                  ScreenOff:     sta Mirror_PPU_CTRL_REG2  ;save bits for later but not in register at the moment
0807A 29 E7                                    and #%11100111            ;disable screen for now
0807C 8D 01 20                                 sta PPU_CTRL_REG2
0807F AE 02 20                                 ldx PPU_STATUS            ;reset flip-flop and reset scroll registers to zero
08082 A9 00                                    lda #$00
08084 20 22 F4                                 jsr InitScroll
08087 8D 03 20                                 sta PPU_SPR_ADDR          ;reset spr-ram address register
0808A A9 02                                    lda #$02                  ;perform spr-ram DMA access on $0200-$02ff
0808C 8D 14 40                                 sta SPR_DMA
0808F AE 73 07                                 ldx VRAM_Buffer_AddrCtrl  ;load control for pointer to buffer contents
08092 BD 5E 81                                 lda VRAM_AddrTable_Low,x  ;set indirect at $00 to pointer
08095 85 00                                    sta $00
08097 BD 71 81                                 lda VRAM_AddrTable_High,x
0809A 85 01                                    sta $01
0809C 20 19 F4                                 jsr UpdateScreen          ;update screen with buffer contents
0809F A0 00                                    ldy #$00
080A1 AE 73 07                                 ldx VRAM_Buffer_AddrCtrl  ;check for usage of $0341
080A4 E0 06                                    cpx #$06
080A6 D0 01                                    bne InitBuffer
080A8 C8                                       iny                       ;get offset based on usage
080A9 BE 84 81                  InitBuffer:    ldx VRAM_Buffer_Offset,y
080AC A9 00                                    lda #$00                  ;clear buffer header at last location
080AE 9D 00 03                                 sta VRAM_Buffer1_Offset,x        
080B1 9D 01 03                                 sta VRAM_Buffer1,x
080B4 8D 73 07                                 sta VRAM_Buffer_AddrCtrl  ;reinit address control to $0301
080B7 AD 79 07                                 lda Mirror_PPU_CTRL_REG2  ;copy mirror of $2001 to register
080BA 8D 01 20                                 sta PPU_CTRL_REG2
080BD                                          if SOUND
080BD 20 A5 F5                                      jsr handleSound           ;play sound
080C0                                          endif
080C0 20 CB F4                                 jsr ReadJoypads           ;read joypads
080C3 20 30 F4                                 jsr PauseRoutine          ;handle pause
080C6 20 46 F3                                 jsr RunCustomCode         ;run custom code
080C9 20 D6 8D                                 jsr UpdateTopScore
080CC AD 76 07                                 lda GamePauseStatus       ;check for pause status
080CF 4A                                       lsr
080D0 B0 25                                    bcs PauseSkip
080D2 AD 47 07                                 lda TimerControl          ;if master timer control not set, decrement
080D5 F0 05                                    beq DecTimers             ;all frame and interval timers
080D7 CE 47 07                                 dec TimerControl
080DA D0 19                                    bne NoDecTimers
080DC A2 14                     DecTimers:     ldx #$14                  ;load end offset for end of frame timers
080DE CE 7F 07                                 dec IntervalTimerControl  ;decrement interval timer control,
080E1 10 07                                    bpl DecTimersLoop         ;if not expired, only frame timers will decrement
080E3 A9 14                                    lda #$14
080E5 8D 7F 07                                 sta IntervalTimerControl  ;if control for interval timers expired,
080E8 A2 23                                    ldx #$23                  ;interval timers will decrement along with frame timers
080EA BD 80 07                  DecTimersLoop: lda Timers,x              ;check current timer
080ED F0 03                                    beq SkipExpTimer          ;if current timer expired, branch to skip,
080EF DE 80 07                                 dec Timers,x              ;otherwise decrement the current timer
080F2 CA                        SkipExpTimer:  dex                       ;move onto next timer
080F3 10 F5                                    bpl DecTimersLoop         ;do this until all timers are dealt with
080F5 E6 09                     NoDecTimers:   inc FrameCounter          ;increment frame counter
080F7 A2 00                     PauseSkip:     ldx #$00
080F9 A0 07                                    ldy #$07
080FB AD A7 07                                 lda PseudoRandomBitReg    ;get first memory location of LSFR bytes
080FE 29 02                                    and #%00000010            ;mask out all but d1
08100 85 00                                    sta $00                   ;save here
08102 AD A8 07                                 lda PseudoRandomBitReg+1  ;get second memory location
08105 29 02                                    and #%00000010            ;mask out all but d1
08107 45 00                                    eor $00                   ;perform exclusive-OR on d1 from first and second bytes
08109 18                                       clc                       ;if neither or both are set, carry will be clear
0810A F0 01                                    beq RotPRandomBit
0810C 38                                       sec                       ;if one or the other is set, carry will be set
0810D 7E A7 07                  RotPRandomBit: ror PseudoRandomBitReg,x  ;rotate carry into d7, and rotate last bit into carry
08110 E8                                       inx                       ;increment to next byte
08111 88                                       dey                       ;decrement for loop
08112 D0 F9                                    bne RotPRandomBit
08114 AD 22 07                                 lda Sprite0HitDetectFlag  ;check for flag here
08117 F0 1F                                    beq SkipSprite0
08119 AD 02 20                  Sprite0Clr:    lda PPU_STATUS            ;wait for sprite 0 flag to clear, which will
0811C 29 40                                    and #%01000000            ;not happen until vblank has ended
0811E D0 F9                                    bne Sprite0Clr
08120 AD 76 07                                 lda GamePauseStatus       ;if in pause mode, do not bother with sprites at all
08123 4A                                       lsr
08124 B0 06                                    bcs Sprite0Hit
08126 20 C0 F3                                 jsr MoveSpritesOffscreen
08129 20 74 F3                                 jsr SpriteShuffler
0812C AD 02 20                  Sprite0Hit:    lda PPU_STATUS            ;do sprite #0 hit detection
0812F 29 40                                    and #%01000000
08131 F0 F9                                    beq Sprite0Hit
08133 A0 14                                    ldy #$14                  ;small delay, to wait until we hit horizontal blank time
08135 88                        HBlankDelay:   dey
08136 D0 FD                                    bne HBlankDelay
08138 AD 3F 07                  SkipSprite0:   lda HorizontalScroll      ;set scroll registers from variables
0813B 8D 05 20                                 sta PPU_SCROLL_REG
0813E AD 40 07                                 lda VerticalScroll
08141 8D 05 20                                 sta PPU_SCROLL_REG
08144 AD 78 07                                 lda Mirror_PPU_CTRL_REG1  ;load saved mirror of $2000
08147 48                                       pha
08148 8D 00 20                                 sta PPU_CTRL_REG1
0814B AD 76 07                                 lda GamePauseStatus       ;if in pause mode, do not perform operation mode stuff
0814E 4A                                       lsr
0814F B0 03                                    bcs SkipMainOper
08151 20 86 81                                 jsr OperModeExecutionTree ;otherwise do one of many, many possible subroutines
08154 AD 02 20                  SkipMainOper:  lda PPU_STATUS            ;reset flip-flop
08157 68                                       pla
08158 09 80                                    ora #%10000000            ;reactivate NMIs
0815A 8D 00 20                                 sta PPU_CTRL_REG1
0815D 40                                       rti                       ;we are done until the next frame!
0815E                           
0815E                           ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0815E                           
0815E                           endif

081A8                           GameMenuRoutine:
081A8 A0 00                                   ldy #$00
081AA AD FC 06                                lda SavedJoypad1Bits        ;check to see if either player pressed
081AD 0D FD 06                                ora SavedJoypad2Bits        ;only the start button (either joypad)
081B0 C9 10                                   cmp #Start_Button
081B2 F0 04                                   beq StartGame
081B4 C9 90                                   cmp #A_Button+Start_Button  ;check to see if A + start was pressed
081B6 D0 03                                   bne ChkSelect               ;if not, branch to check select button
081B8 4C 3B 82                  StartGame:    jmp ChkContinue             ;if either start or A + start, execute here
081BB C9 20                     ChkSelect:    cmp #Select_Button          ;check to see if the select button was pressed
081BD F0 1A                                   beq SelectBLogic            ;if so, branch reset demo timer
081BF AE A2 07                                ldx DemoTimer               ;otherwise check demo timer
081C2 D0 0B                                   bne ChkWorldSel             ;if demo timer not expired, branch to check world selection
081C4 8D 80 07                                sta SelectTimer             ;set controller bits here if running demo
081C7 20 DD F4                                jsr DemoEngine              ;run through the demo actions
081CA B0 60                                   bcs ResetTitle              ;if carry flag set, demo over, thus branch
081CC 4C 23 82                                jmp RunDemo                 ;otherwise, run game engine for demo
081CF AE FC 07                  ChkWorldSel:  ldx WorldSelectEnableFlag   ;check to see if world selection has been enabled
081D2                                         if !(CHEATS && CHEAT_WORLD_SELECT)
081D2 F0 4A                                     beq NullJoypad
081D4                                         endif
081D4 C9 40                                   cmp #B_Button               ;if so, check to see if the B button was pressed
081D6 D0 46                                   bne NullJoypad
081D8 C8                                      iny                         ;if so, increment Y and execute same code as select
081D9 AD A2 07                  SelectBLogic: lda DemoTimer               ;if select or B pressed, check demo timer one last time
081DC F0 4E                                   beq ResetTitle              ;if demo timer expired, branch to reset title screen mode
081DE A9 18                                   lda #$18                    ;otherwise reset demo timer

081E6 D0 36                                   bne NullJoypad              ;if not expired, branch
081E8 A9 10                                   lda #$10                    ;otherwise reset select button timer
081EA 8D 80 07                                sta SelectTimer
081ED C0 01                                   cpy #$01                    ;was the B button pressed earlier?  if so, branch
081EF F0 0E                                   beq IncWorldSel             ;note this will not be run if world selection is disabled
081F1 AD 7A 07                                lda NumberOfPlayers         ;if no, must have been the select button, therefore
081F4 49 01                                   eor #%00000001              ;change number of players and draw icon accordingly
081F6 8D 7A 07                                sta NumberOfPlayers
081F9 20 8F 82                                jsr DrawMushroomIcon
081FC 4C 1E 82                                jmp NullJoypad
081FF AE 6B 07                  IncWorldSel:  ldx WorldSelectNumber       ;increment world select number
08202 E8                                      inx

08209 20 73 82                                jsr GoContinue
0820C BD A2 81                  UpdateShroom: lda WSelectBufferTemplate,x ;write template for world select in vram buffer
0820F 9D 00 03                                sta VRAM_Buffer1-1,x        ;do this until all bytes are written
08212 E8                                      inx
08213 E0 06                                   cpx #$06
08215 30 F5                                   bmi UpdateShroom
08217 AC 5F 07                                ldy WorldNumber             ;get world number from variable and increment for
0821A C8                                      iny                         ;proper display, and put in blank byte before
0821B 8C 04 03                                sty VRAM_Buffer1+3          ;null terminator
0821E A9 00                     NullJoypad:   lda #$00                    ;clear joypad bits for player 1
08220 8D FC 06                                sta SavedJoypad1Bits
08223                                         if TEST_LUIGI

08223                                         endif

087DF AD 26 07                              lda CurrentColumnPos         ;store LSB of where we're at

087F1 AD 20 07                              lda CurrentNTAddr_High
087F4 99 41 03                              sta VRAM_Buffer2,y
087F7 A9 9A                                 lda #$9a                     ;store length byte of 26 here with d7 set
087F9 99 43 03                              sta VRAM_Buffer2+2,y         ;to increment by 32 (in columns)

087FE 85 04                                 sta $04
08800 AA                                    tax
08801 86 01                     DrawMTLoop: stx $01                      ;store init value of 0 or incremented offset for buffer
08803 BD A1 06                              lda MetatileBuffer,x         ;get first metatile number, and mask out all but 2 MSB
08806 29 C0                                 and #%11000000
08808 85 03                                 sta $03                      ;store attribute table bits here
0880A 0A                                    asl                          ;note that metatile format is:
0880B 2A                                    rol                          ;%xx000000 - attribute table bits, 
0880C 2A                                    rol                          ;%00xxxxxx - metatile number
0880D A8                                    tay                          ;rotate bits to d1-d0 and use as offset here
0880E B9 33 8A                              lda MetatileGraphics_Low,y   ;get address to graphics table from here
08811 85 06                                 sta $06
08813 B9 37 8A                              lda MetatileGraphics_High,y
08816 85 07                                 sta $07
08818 BD A1 06                              lda MetatileBuffer,x         ;get metatile number again
0881B 0A                                    asl                          ;multiply by 4 and use as tile offset
0881C 0A                                    asl
0881D 85 02                                 sta $02
0881F AD 1F 07                              lda AreaParserTaskNum        ;get current task number for level processing and
08822 29 01                                 and #%00000001               ;mask out all but LSB, then invert LSB, multiply by 2
08824 49 01                                 eor #%00000001               ;to get the correct column position in the metatile,
08826 0A                                    asl                          ;then add to the tile offset so we can draw either side
08827 65 02                                 adc $02                      ;of the metatiles
08829 A8                                    tay
0882A A6 00                                 ldx $00                      ;use vram buffer offset from before as X
0882C B1 06                                 lda ($06),y

08D4A A5 00                           lda $00            ;move high nybble to low
08D4C 4A                              lsr                ;and print to score display

08D50                           OutputNumbers:
08D50 18                                     clc                      ;add 1 to low nybble
08D51 69 01                                  adc #$01
08D53 29 0F                                  and #%00001111           ;mask out high nybble
08D55                                        if CHEATS && CHEAT_REMOVE_TIMER
08D55                                           ; skip the last digit output (game time)
08D55                                           cmp #$05
08D55                                        else
08D55 C9 06                                     cmp #$06
08D57                                        endif
08D57                                        
08D57 B0 44                                  bcs ExitOutputN
08D59 48                                     pha                      ;save incremented value to stack for now and
08D5A 0A                                     asl                      ;shift to left and use as offset
08D5B A8                                     tay
08D5C AE 00 03                               ldx VRAM_Buffer1_Offset  ;get current buffer pointer
08D5F A9 20                                  lda #$20                 ;put at top of screen by default
08D61 C0 00                                  cpy #$00                 ;are we writing top score on title screen?
08D63 D0 02                                  bne SetupNums
08D65 A9 22                                  lda #$22                 ;if so, put further down on the screen
08D67 9D 01 03                  SetupNums:   sta VRAM_Buffer1,x
08D6A B9 2F 8D                               lda StatusBarData,y      ;write low vram address and length of thing
08D6D 9D 02 03                               sta VRAM_Buffer1+1,x     ;we're printing to the buffer
08D70 B9 30 8D                               lda StatusBarData+1,y
08D73 9D 03 03                               sta VRAM_Buffer1+2,x
08D76 85 03                                  sta $03                  ;save length byte in counter
08D78 86 02                                  stx $02                  ;and buffer pointer elsewhere for now
08D7A 68                                     pla                      ;pull original incremented value from stack
08D7B AA                                     tax
08D7C BD 3F 8D                               lda StatusBarOffset,x    ;load offset to value we want to write
08D7F 38                                     sec
08D80 F9 30 8D                               sbc StatusBarData+1,y    ;subtract from length byte we read before
08D83 A8                                     tay                      ;use value as offset to display digits
08D84 A6 02                                  ldx $02
08D86 B9 D7 07                  DigitPLoop:  lda DisplayDigits,y      ;write digits to the buffer
08D89 9D 04 03                               sta VRAM_Buffer1+3,x    
08D8C E8                                     inx
08D8D C8                                     iny
08D8E C6 03                                  dec $03                  ;do this until all the digits are written
08D90 D0 F4                                  bne DigitPLoop
08D92 A9 00                                  lda #$00                 ;put null terminator at end
08D94 9D 04 03                               sta VRAM_Buffer1+3,x
08D97 E8                                     inx                      ;increment buffer pointer by 3
08D98 E8                                     inx
08D99 E8                                     inx
08D9A 8E 00 03                               stx VRAM_Buffer1_Offset  ;store it in case we want to use it again
08D9D 60                        ExitOutputN: rts
08D9E

08D9E                           
08D9E                           DigitsMathRoutine:
08D9E AD 70 07                              lda OperMode              ;check mode of operation
08DA1 C9 00                                 cmp #TitleScreenModeValue
08DA3 F0 16                                 beq EraseDMods            ;if in title screen mode, branch to lock score
08DA5 A2 05                                 ldx #$05
08DA7 BD 34 01                  AddModLoop: lda DigitModifier,x       ;load digit amount to increment
08DAA 18                                    clc
08DAB 79 D7 07                              adc DisplayDigits,y       ;add to current digit
08DAE 30 16                                 bmi BorrowOne             ;if result is a negative number, branch to subtract
08DB0 C9 0A                                 cmp #10
08DB2 B0 19                                 bcs CarryOne              ;if digit greater than $09, branch to add
08DB4 99 D7 07                  StoreNewD:  sta DisplayDigits,y       ;store as new score or game timer digit
08DB7 88                                    dey                       ;move onto next digits in score or game timer
08DB8 CA                                    dex                       ;and digit amounts to increment
08DB9 10 EC                                 bpl AddModLoop            ;loop back if we're not done yet
08DBB A9 00                     EraseDMods: lda #$00                  ;store zero here
08DBD A2 06                                 ldx #$06                  ;start with the last digit
08DBF 9D 33 01                  EraseMLoop: sta DigitModifier-1,x     ;initialize the digit amounts to increment
08DC2 CA                                    dex
08DC3 10 FA                                 bpl EraseMLoop            ;do this until they're all reset, then leave
08DC5 60                                    rts
08DC6 DE 33 01                  BorrowOne:  dec DigitModifier-1,x     ;decrement the previous digit, then put $09 in
08DC9 A9 09                                 lda #$09                  ;the game timer digit we're currently on to "borrow
08DCB D0 E7                                 bne StoreNewD             ;the one", then do an unconditional branch back
08DCD 38                        CarryOne:   sec                       ;subtract ten from our digit to make it a
08DCE E9 0A                                 sbc #10                   ;proper BCD number, then increment the digit
08DD0 FE 33 01                              inc DigitModifier-1,x     ;preceding current digit to "carry the one" properly
08DD3 4C B4 8D                              jmp StoreNewD             ;go back to just after we branched here
08DD6

08031                           ; setLeftCHR sets both left CHR banks
08031                           ; setRightCHR sets all 4 right CHR banks
08031                           ;
08031                           ; The chr is divided like this (but it can be 
08031                           ; inverted to switch which side gets 2 and which
08031                           ; side gets 4 banks).
08031                           ;
08031                           ;______________________  ______________________
08031                           ;| 0                  |  | 2                  |
08031                           ;|                    |  |____________________|
08031                           ;|                    |  | 3                  |
08031                           ;|____________________|  |____________________|
08031                           ;| 1                  |  | 4                  |
08031                           ;|                    |  |____________________|
08031                           ;|                    |  | 5                  |
08031                           ;|____________________|  |____________________|
08031                           
08031                           ; The values used are as if they were all 2k banks.
08031                           ; An example of the values is:
08031                           ; CHR0: 0
08031                           ; CHR1: 2
08031                           ; CHR2: 4
08031                           ; CHR3: 5
08031                           ; CHR4: 6
08031                           ; CHR5; 7
08031

08735                           ;--------------------------------
08735                           
08735                           ;MUSIC DATA
08735                           ;square 2/triangle format
08735                           ;d7 - length byte flag (0-note, 1-length)
08735                           ;if d7 is set to 0 and d6-d0 is nonzero:
08735                           ;d6-d0 - note offset in frequency look-up table (must be even)
08735                           ;if d7 is set to 1:
08735                           ;d6-d3 - unused
08735                           ;d2-d0 - length offset in length look-up table
08735                           ;value of $00 in square 2 data is used as null terminator, affects all sound channels
08735                           ;value of $00 in triangle data causes routine to skip note
08735                           
08735                           ;square 1 format
08735                           ;d7-d6, d0 - length offset in length look-up table (bit order is d0,d7,d6)
08735                           ;d5-d1 - note offset in frequency look-up table
08735                           ;value of $00 in square 1 data is flag alternate control reg data to be loaded
08735                           
08735                           ;noise format
08735                           ;d7-d6, d0 - length offset in length look-up table (bit order is d0,d7,d6)
08735                           ;d5-d4 - beat type (0 - rest, 1 - short, 2 - strong, 3 - long)
08735                           ;d3-d1 - unused
08735                           ;value of $00 in noise data is used as null terminator, affects only noise
08735                           
08735                           ;all music data is organized into sections (unless otherwise stated):
08735                           ;square 2, square 1, triangle, noise
08735                           
08735                           Star_CloudMData:

0F512                           include code\whirlpools.asm
0F512                           ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0F512                           ;$00 - used in WhirlpoolActivate to store whirlpool length / 2, page location of center of whirlpool
0F512                           ;and also to store movement force exerted on player
0F512                           ;$01 - used in ProcessWhirlpools to store page location of right extent of whirlpool
0F512                           ;and in WhirlpoolActivate to store center of whirlpool
0F512                           ;$02 - used in ProcessWhirlpools to store right extent of whirlpool and in
0F512                           ;WhirlpoolActivate to store maximum vertical speed
0F512                           
0F512                           _ProcessWhirlpools:
0F512 AD 4E 07                          lda AreaType                ;check for water type level
0F515 D0 37                             bne ExitWh                  ;branch to leave if not found
0F517 8D 7D 04                          sta Whirlpool_Flag          ;otherwise initialize whirlpool flag
0F51A AD 47 07                          lda TimerControl            ;if master timer control set,
0F51D D0 2F                             bne ExitWh                  ;branch to leave
0F51F A0 04                             ldy #$04                    ;otherwise start with last whirlpool data
0F521 B9 71 04                  WhLoop: lda Whirlpool_LeftExtent,y  ;get left extent of whirlpool
0F524 18                                clc
0F525 79 77 04                          adc Whirlpool_Length,y      ;add length of whirlpool
0F528 85 02                             sta $02                     ;store result as right extent here
0F52A B9 6B 04                          lda Whirlpool_PageLoc,y     ;get page location
0F52D F0 1C                             beq NextWh                  ;if none or page 0, branch to get next data
0F52F 69 00                             adc #$00                    ;add carry
0F531 85 01                             sta $01                     ;store result as page location of right extent here
0F533 A5 76                             lda Player_X_Position       ;get player's horizontal position
0F535 38                                sec
0F536 F9 71 04                          sbc Whirlpool_LeftExtent,y  ;subtract left extent
0F539 A5 5D                             lda Player_PageLoc          ;get player's page location
0F53B F9 6B 04                          sbc Whirlpool_PageLoc,y     ;subtract borrow
0F53E 30 0B                             bmi NextWh                  ;if player too far left, branch to get next data
0F540 A5 02                             lda $02                     ;otherwise get right extent
0F542 38                                sec
0F543 E5 76                             sbc Player_X_Position       ;subtract player's horizontal coordinate
0F545 A5 01                             lda $01                     ;get right extent's page location
0F547 E5 5D                             sbc Player_PageLoc          ;subtract borrow
0F549 10 04                             bpl WhirlpoolActivate       ;if player within right extent, branch to whirlpool code
0F54B 88                        NextWh: dey                         ;move onto next whirlpool data
0F54C 10 D3                             bpl WhLoop                  ;do this until all whirlpools are checked
0F54E 60                        ExitWh: rts                         ;leave
0F54F                           
0F54F                           WhirlpoolActivate:
0F54F B9 77 04                          lda Whirlpool_Length,y      ;get length of whirlpool
0F552 4A                                lsr                         ;divide by 2
0F553 85 00                             sta $00                     ;save here
0F555 B9 71 04                          lda Whirlpool_LeftExtent,y  ;get left extent of whirlpool
0F558 18                                clc
0F559 65 00                             adc $00                     ;add length divided by 2
0F55B 85 01                             sta $01                     ;save as center of whirlpool
0F55D B9 6B 04                          lda Whirlpool_PageLoc,y     ;get page location
0F560 69 00                             adc #$00                    ;add carry
0F562 85 00                             sta $00                     ;save as page location of whirlpool center
0F564 A5 09                             lda FrameCounter            ;get frame counter
0F566 4A                                lsr                         ;shift d0 into carry (to run on every other frame)
0F567 90 2C                             bcc WhPull                  ;if d0 not set, branch to last part of code
0F569 A5 01                             lda $01                     ;get center
0F56B 38                                sec
0F56C E5 76                             sbc Player_X_Position       ;subtract player's horizontal coordinate
0F56E A5 00                             lda $00                     ;get page location of center
0F570 E5 5D                             sbc Player_PageLoc          ;subtract borrow
0F572 10 0E                             bpl LeftWh                  ;if player to the left of center, branch
0F574 A5 76                             lda Player_X_Position       ;otherwise slowly pull player left, towards the center
0F576 38                                sec
0F577 E9 01                             sbc #$01                    ;subtract one pixel
0F579 85 76                             sta Player_X_Position       ;set player's new horizontal coordinate
0F57B A5 5D                             lda Player_PageLoc
0F57D E9 00                             sbc #$00                    ;subtract borrow
0F57F 4C 93 F5                          jmp SetPWh                  ;jump to set player's new page location
0F582 AD 90 04                  LeftWh: lda Player_CollisionBits    ;get player's collision bits
0F585 4A                                lsr                         ;shift d0 into carry
0F586 90 0D                             bcc WhPull                  ;if d0 not set, branch
0F588 A5 76                             lda Player_X_Position       ;otherwise slowly pull player right, towards the center
0F58A 18                                clc
0F58B 69 01                             adc #$01                    ;add one pixel
0F58D 85 76                             sta Player_X_Position       ;set player's new horizontal coordinate
0F58F A5 5D                             lda Player_PageLoc
0F591 69 00                             adc #$00                    ;add carry
